exposure: Nausea and vomiting of pregnancy (NVP) severity
cohort: The study included 8396 nulliparous women enrolled in the U.S. nuMoM2b cohort.
finding: NVP severity alone showed limited impact on short-term pregnancy outcomes, whereas inadequate gestational weight gain was consistently associated with shorter gestation, lower birth weight, and increased risks of preterm birth, LBW, and SGA.
